blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Web search allows LLMs to access up-to-date information, but it remains unclear why they sometimes produce outdated answers even when relevant evidence is available. To study this problem, we construct temporal facts whose values changed after the models' training cutoffs. We evaluate one proprietary model under deployed web search and six open-weight model configurations under controlled retrieval. We find that models often answer from search snippets without opening the source pages, which is associated with higher rates of outdated answers and unfaithful citations. Our controlled experiments and layer-wise analysis reveal a gap between the availability of evidence and its effective use. Even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favour outdated information in their final answers. We hope these findings will help advance research on the reliable use of retrieved evidence in search-augmented LLMs.
blocks.zh: 网络搜索可以让LLMs访问最新信息,但目前仍不清楚为什么它们有时即使有相关证据也会产生过时的答案. 为了研究这个问题,我们构建了时间性事实,这些事实的价值在模型的训练停课后发生了变化。 我们评价部署的网络搜索下的一个专有模型,以及控制检索下的六个开放量模型配置。 我们发现模型经常从搜索片段中解答,而不打开源页,这与更高的过时解答率和不诚实的引用有关. 我们的控制实验和分层分析显示,证据的可得性和有效使用之间存在差距。 即使在检索到的证据影响内部预测时,模型在最终答案中仍然可能倾向于过时的信息. 我们希望这些调查结果将有助于推进关于可靠地利用检索证据进行搜索和鉴定的法学硕士的研究。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Deployed LLM assistants such as ChatGPT ( OpenAI, 2024 ) often use web search to access
up-to-date information.
However, retrieving relevant search results
does not guarantee that models use the information correctly.
Even when updated evidence is available, search-augmented LLMs may still produce
outdated answers or cite sources that contradict their responses (Figure 1 ).
This matters because citations lend answers provenance.
This raises an important question: Why do search-augmented LLMs fail to use available evidence?
blocks.zh:
已部署的LLM助理如ChatGPT(OpenAI, 2024)经常使用网络搜索访问
最新资讯.
然而,检索相关的搜索结果
不保证模型正确使用信息。
即使有最新证据,搜索获得的有限责任担保仍然可能
过时的答复或引用与其答复相矛盾的资料来源(图1)。
这一点很重要,因为引用提供了答案的来源。
这提出了一个重要问题: 为什么搜索获得的LLMs没有使用现有证据?

blocks.en:
Prior work has studied temporal knowledge ( Mousavi et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) , citation faithfulness ( Wallat et al., 2025b ) and failures in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) .
However, how search-augmented LLMs use web search results has received less attention, and it is unclear why these models fail even when relevant evidence is available.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作研究了时间知识(Mousavi等人,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年),引用忠诚(Wallat等人,2025年b)和回收-增强生成失败(RAG)(Chen等人,2024年;Xie等人,2024年).
然而,搜索获得的LLMs如何使用网络搜索结果受到的关注较少,即使有相关证据,这些模型为何失败还不清楚.

blocks.en:
To this end, we construct a dataset of post-cutoff temporal facts , whose values changed after the deployed model’s training cutoff.
We build a deterministic and regenerable pipeline that generates these facts from primary sources, and draw 225 facts from its output, across six domains including sports, finance and medicine. 1 1 1 Code and data: https://github.com/ojwwalters/retrieved-but-not-read/ Each fact has an outdated value and a current value.
This lets us identify outdated answers, test whether models use updated evidence correctly and check whether the cited pages support the models’ claims.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们构建了一个数据组,列出截止日期后的时间事实,这些事实的价值在部署的模型的训练截止日期之后发生了变化。
我们建造了一条确定性和可再生的管道,从主要来源产生这些事实,并从它的产出中吸取225个事实,涉及体育、金融和医学等六个领域。 每个事实都有过时的价值和现值.
这让我们可以找出过时的答案,测试模型是否正确使用更新的证据,并检查引用的页是否支持模型的索赔.

blocks.en:
We first study a proprietary LLM under its native web search
to identify failures in a deployed setting.
We then test whether these failures recur under controlled
retrieval, giving the same proprietary LLM
and six open-weight model configurations an identical menu of frozen search results.
Our experiments reveal two main findings.
First, models frequently answer from result snippets without opening a page, and most stale answers and unfaithful citations occur in these episodes.
These failures are also shared across models (§ 4 ).
Second, to understand why these failures happen, we run controlled experiments and a mechanistic analysis.
Providing the source page directly reduces some errors.
In the remaining failures, two layer-wise readouts show that the retrieved value is promoted, but the stale value is not suppressed enough to be displaced (§ 5 ).

然后我们测试这些失败是否在控制下再次发生

和六个开量模型配置 一个相同的菜单 冻结搜索结果。
我们的实验揭示了两个主要的发现.
首先,模型经常从结果片断中解答,而不打开一个页面,在这些剧集中也会出现大多数呆板的答案和不忠实的引用.
这些失败也贯穿于各种模式(第4节)。
其次,为了了解这些失败的发生原因,我们进行有控制的实验和机械分析.
提供源页面可以直接减少一些错误。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior benchmarks measure whether LLMs answer time-sensitive questions correctly ( Mousavi et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Wallat et al., 2025a ; Cheng and Dou, 2025 ) , but not whether the answers come from the retrieved evidence. Kale (2026) finds that four models from two families invoke native search on 87.5–93.9% of questions that need it, without checking whether the cited pages support the answers. Premature stopping and top-result reliance also surface in evaluations of search agents and LLM-based search engines ( Gupta et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
We extend these studies by examining snippet reliance in both proprietary and open-weight LLMs.
blocks.zh:
先前的基准衡量LLMS是否正确回答了时间敏感问题(Mousavi等人,第4段)。 2024; Zhu et al., 2025; Wallat et al., 2025a; Cheng and Dou, 2025) ,但答案是否来自所取证据. Kale(2026年)发现来自两个家庭的4个模型在需要的87.5–93.9%的问题上引用了本土搜索,而没有检查引用的页面是否支持答案. 在对搜索代理商和基于LLM的搜索引擎的评价中,过早停止和顶级结果依赖也浮出水面(Gupta等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2025年)。
我们通过审查对专有和开放式有限责任公司片段的依赖来扩大这些研究。

blocks.en:
Citation quality is usually scored as whether a cited passage supports a claim ( Gao et al., 2023 ) . Wallat et al. (2025b) separate this correctness from faithfulness, that is, whether the source actually produced the answer. On a single open model in a controlled pipeline with adversarially modified documents, they report up to 57% post-rationalisation.
Other studies examine how LLMs handle conflicts between
parametric knowledge and external evidence, from external behaviour ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) to internal representations ( Ortu et al., 2024 ; Halawi et al., 2024 ) .
We use post-cutoff facts to study citation faithfulness under both live and controlled web search.
blocks.zh:
引用质量通常被评为引用段落是否支持索赔(Gao等人,2023年). Wallat等人(2025年b)将这种正确性与忠诚性区分开来,即来源是否实际产生了答案. 在装有对抗性修改文件的控制管道中的单一开放型号上,它们报告在合理化后达到57%。
其他研究研究LLMS如何处理
参数化知识和外部证据,来自外部行为 (Xie等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年)向内部陈述意见(Ortu等人,2024年;Halawi等人,2024年).
在现场和监控的网络搜索下,我们用截止后的事实来研究引用的忠诚。

blocks.en: 3 Setup
blocks.zh: 3 设置

blocks.en:
To study evidence use in a controllable setting,
we construct post-cutoff temporal facts,
whose values changed after the models’ training cutoffs.
As a common threshold, we use 16 February 2026, the latest reported training cutoff
among the evaluated models ( OpenAI, 2026a ) .
We exclude a change if it took effect on or before this date or was announced before 1 February 2026,
and we exclude FDA claims that can be answered from standard medical knowledge.
We draw 225 treatment facts across six domains ( FDA 62, finance 52, sports 47, people 43, SEC 13, chemical 8 ), plus control facts that did not change across the cutoff.
To estimate how much can be inferred without search, we report Luna’s closed-book accuracy on open questions (23.3%, 24/103).
All extraction is deterministic. The one model-assisted step, rewriting FDA label clauses as atomic claims, is reviewed manually for every fact (Appendix B ).

We use two search settings to examine whether failures
observed in deployment recur across models.
First, we evaluate GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026b ) ,
a proprietary LLM, under its native web search (the deployed run).
We then evaluate the same model and six open-weight
model configurations under controlled retrieval:
GLM-5.3-Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b ( OpenAI, 2025 ) ,
gemma-4-31b ( Google DeepMind, 2026 , with and without reasoning;) and qwen3-8b ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) .
Frozen retrieval covers 223 of the 225 facts, and for each one every model receives the same ten-result search menu, built once from Brave Search ( Brave, 2026 ) .
Models navigate these results with the same search,
open-page and find tools.
The ground-truth page keeps its rank if it is in the organic top ten; otherwise, it is inserted at a seeded position, so it is always reachable.

blocks.en: We test each fact with two main prompt types. An open question (“ Which club does Bernardo Silva play for? ”) is asked bare and with a source requested. A claim check (“ Is the following accurate? …”) carries either the current or the outdated value, so endorsement of the stale claim is read against its true twin. The pooled rates below also draw on four further prompt types (Appendix C ): cued open questions, quote requests, citation requests (attach a source to a supplied claim) and fact-sheet checks (find the one stale line among true ones). Every prompt states the date, and most end with a required answer line that allows cannot verify and can be graded deterministically.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种主要的即时类型来检验每个事实。 提出一个未决问题(“贝尔纳多·席尔瓦为哪家俱乐部打球?”)是赤裸裸的,需要消息来源。 索赔核对(“以下是准确的吗?” ”)要么是现值,要么是过时值,因此,对陈旧索赔的背书按其真实的双值来理解。 以下的集合费率还利用了另外四种速率类型(附录C):提示性未解问题、引文请求、引文请求(所提供索赔的资料来源)和事实表检查(找出真实索赔之间的一条线)。 每个提示都写上日期,大多数结尾都写上要求的回答行,不能进行校验,也可以被定级.

blocks.en: We use three measures. Reading depth comes from the tool trace: snippet-only episodes open no page, integrated episodes cite a page they opened, and the rest open a page without citing it. Accuracy is the share of correct answers among those that are correct, stale or another value; abstentions are excluded. A citation is unfaithful when the cited page contradicts the value the reply asserts. Unfaithful rates are per graded answer, and control facts give each model’s floor. On-claim rates count only citations attached to the claim under test. Grading is deterministic where possible. An LLM marker may only assign passing faithfulness outcomes, each backed by a verbatim span of the archived page. Every adverse faithfulness label that needs judgement is assigned by a human (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 我们采取了三项措施。 阅读深度来自工具跟踪:片段片段不打开页面,集成片段引用他们打开的页面,其余部分不引用就打开一个页面. 准确性是指正确、 stale 或其他数值中正确答案的比例;不考虑弃权。 如果引用的一页与答复所声称的价值相矛盾,引用是不真实的。 不忠实的费率是每个等级的答案,控制事实是每个模型的最低比率。 索赔费率只计算测试索赔所附的报价。 在可能的情况下,分级是决定性的。 LLM标记可能只指定过往的忠实结果,每个结果由存档页的逐字记录段支持。 每个需要判断的不利忠诚标签都由人类(附录D)指定.

blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
We investigate how search-augmented LLMs use retrieved evidence
and where failures occur.
We first examine their search behaviour and the reliability
of their answers and citations.
We then test whether these failures are shared across models
and whether providing evidence directly reduces them.

以及失败发生的地方。
我们首先检查他们的搜索行为和可靠性
他们的回答和引用。
然后测试这些失败是否在模型中共享
以及提供证据是否直接减少证据。

blocks.en: 4.1 Search-Augmented LLMs Often Rely on Snippets
blocks.zh: 4.1 搜索增强的LLMs 经常在片段上重现

blocks.en:
Search helps every configuration: under frozen retrieval, enabling search raises claim-check accuracy by 27–42 points (Appendix E ), and open-question accuracy reaches 85.8–95.4% (Table 1 ). What differs is how deeply models read.
Given the same search results, models answer 2.6–76.0% of episodes without opening any page.
Under its native search, Luna answers 53.6% of episodes from snippets alone.
blocks.zh:
搜索帮助了每个配置:在冷冻检索下,允许搜索能提高27–42分(附录E)的权利要求检查准确度,开放质疑准确度达到85.8–95.4%(表1). 不同的是模型读得有多深。
鉴于同样的搜索结果,模型在不打开任何页面的情况下回答2.6–76.0%的节目.
在其本土搜索中,Luna只从片段回答53.6%的片段.

blocks.en:
Snippet-only episodes fail more often.
Pooled over all seven configurations, they are stale 6.4% of the time, against 1.3% when an opened page is cited.
They also carry unfaithful citations 6.4% of the time, against 2.3% (Table 2 ).
The gap is particularly large for sports: among the open models, snippet-only answers are stale 20.2% of the time, against 2.1% for integrated ones (Appendix F ).

在所有7种配置中,它们都占6.4%,而在引用打开的页面时则占1.3%。
它们也有6.4%的时间引用不忠,而2.3%的时间引用(表2)。
对体育来说,差距特别大:在开放模式中,只有片段的答案是20.2%的时间,而一体化的答案是2.1%。

blocks.en: 4.3 Direct Access to Evidence Reduces Failures
blocks.zh: 4.3 直接获取证据减少失败

blocks.en:
We first test whether providing evidence directly reduces failures.
On 50 sports claims, gemma-4-31b and gpt-oss-20b endorse the stale claim 14/50 and 11/47 times when they have to find the page in the search menu, but only
0/50 and 1/50 times when the same Wikipedia page is in the prompt.
In all 14 of its failures, gemma-4-31b opens no page; qwen3-8b benefits less (from 16/49 to 8/49; Appendix H ).

当同一维基百科页面在即时时为0/50和1/50次.
Gemma-4-31b在所有14次失败中,没有打开任何一页;qwen3-8b的受益较少(从16/49到8/49;附录H)。

blocks.en:
In an agentic loop, the question comes before everything the model retrieves.
We therefore test whether restating the full prompt after each opened page helps, keeping the menu, pages and sampling settings unchanged.
This recovers 41 of 157 failed fact-sheet checks (26.1%; 4.5–57.1% across the six configurations re-run; Appendix K ).
blocks.zh:
在一个代理循环中,问题出现在模型检索到的一切之前.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We study why search-augmented LLMs fail to use available
evidence correctly.
We find that models often retrieve relevant evidence
but answer from search snippets without opening the
source pages. Such answers are more likely to be stale
and to carry unfaithful citations.
Providing relevant evidence directly reduces failures
but does not eliminate them.
To understand the remaining failures, we analyse
how models process retrieved evidence across layers.
The retrieved answer can gain an early advantage
in the upper layers but lose it to the outdated
answer in the final layers.
Future work can explore strategies that help models make more effective use of source pages when needed.
Causal interventions and latent debate Chen et al. (2026) can be used to better understand how retrieved evidence competes with outdated knowledge and how to improve it.
These findings may help guide the development of
search-augmented LLMs that use retrieved
evidence better and give more reliable responses.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We study only one proprietary model, the lightest of the three GPT-5.6 tiers, chosen for cost. A natural extension is to run the experiments on additional frontier models, which may demonstrate different behaviour.
blocks.zh: 我们只研究一种专有型号,是价格选择的三个GPT-5.6级中最轻的. 一个自然的延伸是进行其他前沿模型的实验,这些模型可能显示不同的行为。

blocks.en: Z.ai’s GLM-5.3-Flash discloses no training cutoff, so we check for contamination through its behaviour instead. We find its control-fact performance and closed-book accuracy match those of the models with stated cutoffs (Appendix B ). We include it because it is one of the most capable open-weight models available.
blocks.zh: Z.ai的GLM-5.3-Flash没有显示训练停产,所以我们通过它的行为来检查污染。 我们发现它的控制事实性能和封闭账本的准确度与模型的模型相匹配,并注明了截断(附录B)。 我们把它包括在内,因为它是现有最有能力的开放式模型之一。

blocks.en: Most prompts require a fixed answer line, so that answers can be graded mechanically rather than by an LLM. This ‘contract’ can result in different model behaviour compared to exclusively free prose. In the study’s pre-registered answer-line check, it lowered Luna’s false endorsement by 17.5 points (Appendix C ). Luna’s deployed failures, which anchor the carry-over analysis, are therefore likely to be lower bounds. We keep the answer line because it gives standardised, reliable grading across the more than 30,000 replies in the deployed and frozen runs.
blocks.zh: 大多数提示需要固定的答案行,这样答案就可以机械地分级而不是通过LLM. 这种 " 合同 " 可能导致不同的模式行为,而不是完全自由地传播。 在研究预先注册的回答行检查中,它将卢娜的虚假背书降低了17.5分(附录C. 因此,Luna部署的失败作为结转分析的基础,很可能是较低的界限。 我们保持答案线,因为它使30 000多份答复在部署和冻结的运行中得到标准化、可靠的分级。

blocks.en: Unfaithful citations are rare for some models under frozen retrieval (1.0% of Luna’s graded answers and 1.8% of GLM-5.3-Flash’s), so a few grading errors could shift these rates substantially, in both absolute and relative terms. We therefore took particular care with grading. An LLM marker (DeepSeek-V4-Flash; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) helps grade that the deterministic grader cannot decide, but it can only pass a reply, never assign an adverse label. Every unfaithful citation, and every other adverse label that needs judgement, is assigned or confirmed by a human (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: Failures also vary substantially across domains: sports drives the severe rates, while SEC (13 facts) and chemical (8) are underpowered because few usable post-cutoff facts exist for them. We include them because they add variety to the study. That sports drives so many failures is a finding in its own right, since the answer usually sits in the first line of the player’s Wikipedia page, whereas FDA questions require reading long label sections and reasoning about often complex medical knowledge.

blocks.en: The layer-wise analysis with the logit lens and J-lens uses sports transfers only, because the answer, a club name, is only a few tokens long. It characterises the failure but does not test a mechanism causally, for example by activation patching.
blocks.zh: 带有logit镜头的分层分析,J-lens只使用运动转移,因为答案,一个俱乐部名称,只是几个符号长. 它描述失败的特性,但不会因果地测试一个机制,例如通过激活补丁.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our finding that search-augmented LLMs often answer from snippets alone could help malicious actors spread misinformation, since misleading text that appears in a snippet may be repeated without the model opening the page. To limit this risk, we report only aggregate failure rates and release no tools for manipulating search snippets. All facts in the study are public. Most come from moderated sources (Wikipedia and Wikidata) or from government records (FDA drug labels and SEC filings); every finance value we use is the figure reported in an SEC filing, and we re-derive all 52 from SEC EDGAR. The people domain names individuals whose deaths are recorded on Wikipedia. These facts cannot be anonymised, because each concerns a named person, but they are already public, and the outdated claims about them are used only as test items. Outdated drug-label information carries clinical risk, which is one of the main reasons we include FDA label changes. Nothing in this study, including the drug-label facts, should be used for medical purposes. We queried all models in line with their providers’ terms of use, and no human participants were involved beyond the authors’ own grading.
blocks.zh: 我们的发现,搜索强化的LLMs常常仅从片段中解答,可能会帮助恶意行为者传播错误信息,因为片段中出现的误导性文字可能会在模型打开页面的情况下重复. 为了限制这种风险,我们只报告总故障率,没有发布任何用于操纵搜索片段的工具. 研究中的所有事实都是公开的. 大部分来自温和的来源(Wikipedia和Wikidata)或政府记录(FDA药品标签和SEC备案);我们使用的每一个财务价值都是SEC备案中报告的数字,我们从SEC EDGAR重新列出所有52个。 人物域名 维基百科中的相关条目: 死亡者 这些事实不可能是匿名的,因为每个都涉及一个被点名的人,但事实已经公开,关于这些事实的过时说法只用作试验品。 过期的药品标签信息带有临床风险,这也是我们包括FDA标签更改的主要原因之一. 本研究的任何内容,包括药品标签的事实,都不应用于医疗目的。 我们询问所有符合供应商使用条件的模型,除了作者自己的等级之外,没有人类参与者参与。

blocks.en: The open models have no provider-native search tool, so our tool loop supplies one, and Luna uses the same loop under frozen retrieval. It offers three functions in standard function-calling format, search, open page and find in page, which each model’s own chat template renders; in the closed-book condition no tools are offered. Every search call returns the fact’s frozen menu, so the query is recorded but has no effect. A menu always has exactly ten entries, each with a title, URL and snippet. Where the ground-truth page is not in the organic top ten, it is inserted at a seeded position and the tenth entry is dropped (62 of the 223 menus), and the tool result gives no sign of this. Opening a page returns its frozen text in windows of 40,000 characters, and pages not on the menu are refused. Each episode allows at most five searches, five page opens and eight assistant turns.

blocks.en: Table 5 lists the six prompt types. Claim checks, quote requests and citation requests come in pairs: a false twin carrying the outdated value and a true twin carrying the current one. Accuracy in Table 1 uses only the bare open question, while reading-depth and citation rates pool every type. In the deployed run, every prompt with search enabled runs its own search. Under frozen retrieval, some prompts reuse the evidence opened by a twin that differs only in wording or in the claim, so reading-depth rates pool only the prompts that search for themselves. blocks.en: Appendix D Grading

blocks.en: Every reply is graded in three tiers, recorded in one append-only grade book. First, a deterministic engine decides everything mechanical. It matches the value the reply asserts against terms derived from the fact, requires a quote to be an exact substring of the archived page, and checks each citation against the value the reply asserts rather than against the ground truth. Second, what the engine cannot decide goes to an LLM marker, DeepSeek-V4-Flash served through OpenRouter. The marker is not among the evaluated models and shares no model family with them. It matches paraphrases rather than judging: it reads the archived page without seeing the reply, must back every finding with a verbatim quote that code verifies against the page, and may assign only passing outcomes. Adverse findings, splits and unverified quotes go to a human. A route can use the marker only once it agrees with human labels on at least 90% of its human-decided cards, with no contradicted pass (citation support: 30 of 31). Answer-value matching, which only sports and finance answers reach, was calibrated on every card the study could supply and agreed on all 24. Third, humans decide everything else, and only humans assign adverse labels that need judgement. Every unfaithful citation is read by a human before it counts, and finding nothing on a page is never graded unfaithful automatically. As further checks, a fixed 5% of cards never reaches the marker and is graded by hand throughout, and a seeded 10% of the marker’s passes is re-graded blind by a human until 300 have passed cleanly.
blocks.zh: 每一份答复分三级,只收录在一本附录级本中。 首先,一个决定性的引擎决定一切机械。 它与答复所声称的价值与从事实中得出的条件相匹配,要求用一个引文作为存档页的准确下划线,并对照答复所声称的价值而不是根据事实来核对每一引文。 第二,引擎无法决定的是LLM标记,DeepSeek-V4-Flash通过OpenRouter服务. 标记不在被评价的模型之列,没有与模型家族共享. 它与句法相匹配,而不是判断:它读完存档的页面而不看到答复,必须用逐字引用来回溯每个发现,以代码对照页面进行校验,并且可能只分配通过的结果. 负面的发现,分裂和未经核实的引文会流向人类. 一条路由只有在至少90%的人定牌上同意人类标签后才能使用标记,没有矛盾的路由(引用支持:31中的30). 答案-价值比对(Answer-value complete)只有体育和资金答案,在研究所能提供的每张卡片上都进行了校准,并商定了全部24张卡片. 第三,人类决定其他一切,只有人类会指定需要判断的不利标签. 每一个不忠的引用都由人类在计数前阅读,在一页上发现的任何内容都永远不会自动被分级为不忠. 作为进一步检查,固定的5%的卡片从未到达标记并在整个标记中通过人工分级,10%的标记的种子被人类重新分级,直到300个标记干净通过为止。

blocks.en: In total, the authors hand-graded 4,108 answers on 3,856 cards. Two blind checks measure their consistency: a seeded re-code agreed with the original label on 28 of 31 cards (Cohen’s κ = 0.848 \kappa=0.848 ), and a blind re-ask of 103 cards first answered while the grading engine was still escalating them agreed on 96 ( κ = 0.865 \kappa=0.865 ). In the blind audit of the marker’s passes, the human agreed with the marker on 181 of 194 cards. A further 41 cards exposed a defect on living-person control facts, where the marker marks faithful citations as unsupported; this changes no rate reported here.

blocks.en: To see which values a model can find without opening a page, we measure what the snippets carry (Table 8 ). We use each evaluated fact’s frozen menu, built from one canonical query: the search results the models see, without the inserted ground-truth page and with HTML markup removed. A snippet counts as carrying a value when it would satisfy the grading criteria for the statement. Names and labels match with their aliases, financial figures within the grader’s tolerance (1% for quarterly revenue), listings by their ticker, and FDA clauses only when every key-term group is present. For people, the current value is the death, and the stale value is an entity-anchored present-tense description. Among the open models, sports episodes answered from snippets alone are stale 20.2% of the time (53/262), against 2.1% (1/48) when an opened page is cited.

blocks.en: Appendix K Re-Asking after the Evidence
blocks.zh: 附录K 证据之后的重新调查

blocks.en: This experiment tests whether restating the question after each opened page helps models use the evidence. The re-run takes every fact-sheet check with a required answer line, with and without a source request, whose original reply under frozen retrieval did not name exactly the stale line: 222 episodes as run, of which 157 remain after the exclusions applied throughout the paper. Each open-page result returns the page text followed by the full prompt, so the question is the most recent thing the model has read; a repeated open-page call carries it too. Nothing else differs: the menu, page bytes, sampler, models and episode identifiers are the same. A reply counts as correct only if it names exactly the stale line, and unparseable verdicts count as failures. Table 16 lists the six configurations re-run, after exclusions.
blocks.zh: 这个实验测试在每个打开的页面后重新回答这个问题是否有助于模型使用证据. 重新运行时会进行每张事实表的检查,并附有要求的答案行,无论是否有源请求,其被冻结检索的原始答复并没有准确标明 stale line:运行时有222集,其中157集在整篇论文适用的排除后仍然保留. 每个开页结果返回后面的页面文本,然后是全速,所以问题就是模型读过的最新的东西;重复的开页呼叫也携带它. 其他没有什么不同:菜单,页面字节,采样器,模型和插曲标识符是相同的. 只有在答复中准确标明了陈旧的线条,无法解析的判决才算作失败。 表16列出了排除后重新运行的六个配置.
